generation_prompt: Generate a transparent 1-row x 2-column orthographic atlas of the same circular Hunting River reed clump. LEFT cell is TOP, viewed straight down: overhead plan showing the full round water/soil footprint, radial green leaf fans splayed outward, lily leaves/river stones in exact source positions, and the tiny circular brown ends of cattail stalks (not tall catkin faces). No upright reed stalk silhouettes, no perspective. RIGHT cell is BOTTOM, viewed straight up: opaque natural muddy root mat/soil underside with submerged root bases and small stones, full circular footprint, no visible green upper leaves, tall reeds, or catkin tops. Match the same source brown cattail, green foliage, blue water and rocks. Both views stay centered at identical shared object scale with transparent gutters and no clipping; crisp pixel-art; no labels/text.

cell_extraction.method: largest alpha connected component >=50000 pixels in the requested half; full component bounds plus 3px antialias padding

expected_result: Inferred orthographic view; not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.
